project.title: Native source-issued password-reset completion
project.goal: Atomically consume recovery links, replace or create the local credential, revoke sessions and preserve access/MFA authority
project.scope: R04/R41 internal admitted-control recovery completion; no request/mail/public transport/physical lifetime/cutover

boundary.responsibility: Unlocked password hashing followed by current-token-authorized atomic recovery completion
boundary.rationale: Recovery must never consume a link without its complete credential/session/audit effects
excludes: Reset request/mail and endpoints, actual handle/lifetime admission, full provider/trusted-device identity parity

scenario.normal.description: Current unique unexpired source-issued token replaces or creates own local credential, consumes own sibling links, deletes all own sessions and commits audit without granting access

scenario.given: Synthetic canonical source-issued recovery records and injected trusted clock

scenario.then: Current unique unexpired source-issued token replaces or creates own local credential, consumes own sibling links, deletes all own sessions and commits audit without granting access

action.password_reset.description: Complete a source-issued one-time recovery link without granting session/access authority

errors.refused: Opaque invalid_credentials, invalid_password, invalid_control, connection/crypto/clock/config errors; NotCommitted or OutcomeUnknown with explicit reuse

preconditions: Caller owns actual admitted control/workspace lifetime and bounded blocking; token is source format, not requested identity
Original password policy precedes NFKC KDF without holding a SQLite transaction; only current unique unexpired row authorizes mutation
postconditions: Credential mutation/creation, all own reset links, own session deletion/lifecycle and audit atomically commit before unit success
Access/email/MFA/provider state is preserved; rollback and uncertain commit never claim false recovery
external_effects: Current control credential/reset/session rows, canonical lifecycle triggers, native_password_reset_v1 workspace_audit and reset-password accepted telemetry; no mail/network/cookie/session issuance

authorization.rationale: The bearer authorizes recovery only under the current writer. Atomic rollback, exact canonical credential ownership and sibling/session invalidation prevent partial recovery, cross-subject changes and replay. No membership or session grant.
